assumptions.text: Single-node baseline ceiling assumed; device count and write rate are unstated.

entries.driver: 1Hz samples per metric per device; bounded packets and in-flight requests per PA-01.
One event per accepted sample or revision; rate equals ingest rate per PA-01.

entries.surface: Windowed telemetry stream HTTP outbound feed
entries.driver: Long-lived subscriptions; fan-out of each window to every subscriber per PA-01.

budgets.limit: At most 600 samples and 1 MiB per packet

measurement.assertion: Oversized packet is rejected with 413 before any append

budgets.target: Packet admission rate per ingestion entry point
budgets.limit: Packets over the configured in-flight cap are rejected

measurement.assertion: Packet beyond the cap receives 429, none queued unbounded
Peak concurrent appends never exceeds the configured permit count

budgets.limit: Capacity bounded per device; overflow applies backpressure, never drops payload

measurement.assertion: Buffer depth never exceeds capacity; excess is refused, not discarded

budgets.limit: At most 100 records per batched write

measurement.assertion: Records per write call never exceed batch limit

budgets.target: Ordered read page by device and metric
budgets.limit: At most 500 rows per page; keyset only

measurement.assertion: One bounded query per page; returned rows at most page limit

budgets.limit: Fixed maximum connections, bounded acquire wait queue

measurement.assertion: Pool maximum and pending-acquire limit are bound to explicit keys
Conflicting append is attempted at most 3 times then fails

budgets.limit: Per-packet and per-storage-call limits bound to keys

measurement.assertion: Timeout keys exist and are applied to each storage call

budgets.target: Ingestion event intake queue in distribution
budgets.limit: Bounded capacity; producer slowed when full

measurement.assertion: Queue depth never exceeds capacity under a producer burst

budgets.limit: Capacity bound to a key; oldest sample evicted

measurement.assertion: Window sample count never exceeds configured capacity

budgets.limit: Fixed capacity of windows per subscriber

measurement.assertion: Slow subscriber buffer never exceeds capacity

budgets.target: Overflow of a slow subscriber buffer
budgets.limit: Drop oldest window with counter; ingestion never blocked

measurement.assertion: Overflow increments drop counter; ingestion progress is unaffected

invariants.rule: No unbounded buffer on the ingestion path.
Ingestion saturation answered by rejection status, never silent payload loss.
Broadcast overflow is drop-with-counter and never blocks ingestion.
No unbounded queue between ingestion events and distribution.

duties.obligation: Reject oversized packets with 413 before processing.
Reject packets over the in-flight cap with 429.
Cap concurrent appends with a fixed permit count.
Bound the reorder buffer; refuse overflow without dropping payload.
Cap keyset page size on ordered reads.
Bound storage pool size and pending acquires.
Retry revision conflicts at most 3 times.
Apply configured deadline to packet and storage calls.
Bound event intake queue; slow producer when full.
Bound sliding window size by configuration.
Reject subscribers beyond the limit with 503.
Drop oldest window on overflow and count it.

risks.risk: Numeric limits are baseline guesses; real device count and rate are unknown.
risks.mitigation: accepted: limits bound to configuration and revisited on measured volume
risks.residual: Limits may be too tight or loose until capacity is measured.

risks.risk: Raw telemetry grows continuously; retention is undefined.
risks.mitigation: operator: retention and partitioning owned by operator
risks.residual: Storage grows unbounded until operator sets retention.

risks.risk: Slow subscribers lose oldest windows under overflow.
risks.residual: Subscribers may miss windows; drop counter exposes the loss.
